messages:
Anya: Heads up — small logistics change. CEO will join ~10:20 (ran late in back-to-back). Can we shift the roadmap slot to 10:10 and move the demo to 10:30? Also noticed the rehearsal local recorder dropped frames during the intro. Anyone available to triage now?
Sam: OK, moving roadmap -> 10:10, demo -> 10:30, Q&A -> 10:45. I’ll update the agenda doc and tell product.
Liz: I can reorder slides. Does moving the demo earlier affect the demo VM network window? @Kevin any concerns?
Kevin: Demo VM backup is fine. For the recorder issue, saw this in the logs earlier:

EngOps Bot: [stream-health] encoder_cpu_high = 75% | frame_drops = 12 | reconnects = 2

Liz: Looks like encoder CPU spike — likely OBS + virtual camera + captions all running on the same host. If CPU >70 we should either drop to 720p or switch to hw encode.
Maria: I can take the local recorder handoff. Suggest fallback plan: start OBS on backup laptop, switch RTMP to the alt ingest, and enable software capture to /mnt/recorder/latest.mp4.
Maria: Fallback commands I’ll run on backup box:
```bash
# start fallback recording to local disk
ffmpeg -f x11grab -video_size 1280x720 -framerate 30 -i :0.0 -f flv rtmp://ingest.alt.redwood/internal-key
# simultaneous local save
ffmpeg -f x11grab -s 1280x720 -r 30 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset fast /mnt/recorder/latest-fallback.mp4
```
Sam: @Maria please go ahead. I’ll notify product and ops that demo is pushed 10 min later.
Anya: @EngOps Bot can you post the alt RTMP key and confirm captions will still route to cloud ASR?
EngOps Bot: ALT_INGEST_KEY=alt_ingest_9x3a | captions_route=cloud-asr-us-east | captions_lag_expected=~3s
Kevin: If we see persistent frame drops after fallback, plan B is to switch to audio-only stream + local recording and stitch later. Triage checklist:
- verify CPU on primary host (`top` / `nvidia-smi`)
- switch to hw encoder (OBS: Settings > Output > Encoder: NVENC)
- if hw not available, lower resolution to 720p
- start alt RTMP and local ffmpeg capture
Anya: Thanks — Maria, Sam, Liz: please confirm when alt feed is live. I’ll update the all-hands page and ping leadership about the slight timing shuffle. :thumbsup:
Maria: Alt feed live & recording started: rtmp://ingest.alt.redwood/alt_ingest_9x3a — local file /mnt/recorder/latest-fallback.mp4. Monitoring audio levels now.
Sam: Agenda doc updated and pinned in #all-hands. Leadership notified.
Liz: Slides reordered, demo presenter queued.
Kevin: Monitoring — CPU stable at 45% on primary after switching encoder. No more frame drops seen in the last 3 minutes.
Anya: Awesome, thank you. Running a quick 30s mic check before we go live at 10:05. Anyone on standby for captioning failover?
EngOps Bot: captions_failover_ready = true | caption_service = cloud-asr-us-east | failover_instructions = call /ops/captions/failover
Anya: Perfect — locking the updated run-of-show and starting the 30s mic check. See you all in the green. :raised_hands:
